License

No Typefield account or license key is required for this beta build.

Install and open.

  1. Download the beta DMG from this page.
  2. Open the DMG and move Typefield to Applications.
  3. Open Typefield. If macOS blocks it, go to System Settings → Privacy & Security, click Open Anyway, then confirm Open. Apple’s instructions ↗

Already have Typefield? Open Settings → Updates to check for a new version. If your copy has no Updates page, download this build and replace the app in Applications once. Your saved library and projects stay in place.
